title: MoveOpening Command
description: Slide one opening along its host, update that opening's record, then rebuild that host wall only. Does not clear the model. Provide delta_mm or absolute t, not both. Id omitted uses the current selection (exactly one opening_marker or opening frame). Refuses a marker or host with forsk:kind=existing or on layer X-EXIST. A refused rebuild leaves the document unchanged.

id.description: Opening marker GUID. Omit to use the current selection.

delta_mm.description: Signed distance along the segment tangent in mm. Exclusive with t.

t.description: Absolute placement along the segment, 0–1. Exclusive with delta_mm.
